requirement.description: {data_dave} asked for the hand-over from the feature store to the training pipeline to be automated. He wants the feature store to feed the training pipeline automatically to ensure data consistency.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} asked for the hand-over from the feature store to the training pipeline to be automated.
requirement.reading: He wants the feature store to feed the training pipeline automatically to ensure data consistency.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are not automating the hand over, you are just making the manual copy faster. I need the feature store to push consistent snapshots directly into the training pipeline so we stop chasing version drift.
output.correction: I am not talking about the storage layer, I am talking about the data lineage between the feature store and the training job. If you log this as an infrastructure upgrade, you will miss the governance point about consistent feature definitions.
